content: Dialogue Acts have been applied to the analysis of spoken BIBREF20, BIBREF21 as well as on-line written synchronous conversations BIBREF22. We apply Dialogue Act tag set defined in BIBREF22 to the analysis of our on-line asynchronous conversations. We argue that Dialogue Acts can be used to analyse user behaviour in social media and verify the presence of therapeutic factors.
